visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side columns of content; with 'alternating', image/text rows whose sides alternate
visualCharacteristics.layout: Cells sit side by side from 900px and stack on mobile
visualCharacteristics.alternating: Image/text rows on white; odd rows image left, even rows image right from 900px; image stacks above the text on mobile. A poster image with a YouTube link shows a blue circular play button and opens the video in a modal dialog

contentPattern.structure: one row per line of columns, one cell per column. With 'alternating': each row has a media cell (image, optionally followed by a youtube.com/watch link for a video) and a text cell (optional H3, paragraphs, lists, links); author the cells in either order
contentPattern.example: Row 1: poster image + https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R2OGCW75eaY | paragraphs, bullet list, bold link 'View our current internship opportunities'

notes: Growth & development internship program row with a video poster: authored as 'Columns (alternating)'
Our workplace model two image/text rows: authored as 'Columns (alternating)'

reuseGuidance: Use 'Columns (alternating)' for stacked image/text rows that swap sides; the block puts the image left on odd rows and right on even rows, whatever the authored cell order. Put a YouTube link under the image to turn it into a video play button. Plain 'Columns' keeps the boilerplate behaviour.
